snippet.title: Clown Camp - B-Movie Survival Horror Game Coming 2026
snippet.description:
First-Person Survival Horror, 90’s style. Hostile clowns lurk the woods. Fight-or-flight to uncover their gruesome secrets throughout a chilling Single-Player Story. Clever inventory management and resourcefulness are your only hopes to escape the Summer of 1999 alive. 

Coming 2026.

Demo Available on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4011730/Clown_Camp_Demo/

Music by https://pixabay.com/users/soundgallerybydmitrytaras-11640913/

Voice Work: Corinne Schroeder, Frederick Schroeder
